scope: Owned automatic redundancy repair and eligible leadership balancing through existing revision-bound membership, fresh-quorum seeding and runtime transfer APIs. Bounded rotating probes and retained metadata, conservative failure classification, startup plan inventory, exact intent reconciliation, pause/resume and joined cancellation.
environment: macOS native Node/SDK/RawNode/Raft Engine/SQLite/LTX/TLS; six actual Nodes, three original voters and three registered standbys; declared zones; shared conditional in-memory object storage. Direct control/query endpoints and one shared advertised data proxy per node preserve data cuts through process-view refresh. No cellar_internal_tests.
limitations: All 248 unique Rust cases across 12 binaries and all 26 commands pass at this source: 241 cellar cases plus seven pure leadership-policy cases. All seven original membership requirements are listed and pass; membership has 25 passes plus one child entry point executed by its parent. Five child entry points across the full matrix are excluded from unique totals. Six new cases include five native scenarios and a pure placement-domain regression. No-business-traffic repair checks the first status only after a fixed five-second autonomous interval. Empty-cell repair precedes the first business command. Minority refusal leaves durable claims unchanged while the conditional object store remains reachable. Eight-group balancing allows caught-up leaders while a control-reachable data-lagging voter remains ineligible, and checks the node-wide attempt bound. Controller/leader loss resumes the exact Seeding plan before later legitimately repairing the old leader. Public Node shutdown is called first under a 15-second bound and verifies the existing Fleet drain phases, joined domain cancellation and closed retained Raft handles. This does not establish a graceful Raft close receipt in NodeOutcome; MR-13 must unify that semantic drain and report archive obligations. Existing explicit RaftCells.close cases retain their own receipt/join checks. Profile capacities and failure domains are declared, not physical qualification. Full snapshot42, archive29, host27, directory16 and the affected Node lifecycle case pass; all88 Node cases retain their separate earlier source record. No physical S3, power loss, real-zone resilience, production performance/capacity, larger physical tiers, federation or complete release qualification is claimed. MR-12 through MR-17 remain open. Existing vendored warnings remain visible.

commands.name: inventory

import json,pathlib,re
p=pathlib.Path('plans/multi-raft'); text=(p/'evidence/MR-11-list.log').read_text(); tasks=json.loads((p/'tasks.json').read_text())['tasks']; required={c['name'] for t in tasks if t['id']=='MR-11' for c in t['test_cases']}; listed=set(re.findall(r'^(\S+): test$',text,re.M)); assert required<=listed,(required-listed); assert 'raft::host::load::tests::partial_and_failed_scans_never_refresh_or_replace_a_complete_sample' in listed; print('All seven MR-11 requirements and bounded load scanner are listed.')
